content.text: I would replace the hand-written parsing in `read_records` with `csv.reader`, so quoted fields with embedded delimiters and escaped quotes are handled. Since `csv.reader` takes only one `quotechar`, accepting both `"` and `'` means either a small preprocessing step or a custom handler for single-quoted fields. I'd look at the current code first to pick the simplest way. I haven't changed anything yet.
